Name: Ches's Sam Portrait Mod
Author: Cheshire348
Description:
[size=4][b][center][size=4][b]Ches's Sam Portrait Mod[/b][/size][/center][/b][/size]

For those who don't want to deviate too much from Stardew's vanilla style, but maybe want Sam to visit a barber real quick. I originally made this for myself, then decided to upload in case anyone else likes it too!
﻿
[center]---------o0~O~0o---------[/center][size=4]
[/size][left][size=4][b][size=3][size=4][b]Status[/b][/size][size=3][b][color=#6aa84f][/color][/b][/size][size=3][b][color=#6aa84f]
[/color][/b][/size][/size][size=3][size=3][color=#a4c2f4]
[/color][/size][/size][size=3][color=#6aa84f]Updated for Stardew 1.6.14[/color]

[/size][/b][/size][b][size=2]It's up and running and everything should be fine, but the newest SV portrait changes are not thoroughly tested so please let me know via Bug reports or Posts if you encounter any issues.[/size][/b][size=4][b][size=3]

Sea[/size][/b][/size][size=4][b][size=3]sonal Villager Out[/size][/b][/size][b][size=3]fits (SVO) Compatibility[/size][/b]

The kind folks over at DSVO did the work of integrating my Sam with theirs! Just download my mod (and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059?tab=description]DSVO[/url]﻿), then select Ches's Sam from the Sam options in DSVO[/left][size=4]
[/size]
